title.zh: ⚡️泰国最高法院正式将比特币裁定为法律意义上的「财产」
title.en: ⚡️泰国最高法院正式将比特币裁定为法律意义上的「财产」

current_state.zh: Thailand’s Supreme Court ruled that bitcoin has economic value, can be held and traded, and may be treated as property in criminal cases, while not recognizing it as legal tender.
current_state.en: Thailand’s Supreme Court ruled that bitcoin has economic value, can be held and traded, and may be treated as property in criminal cases, while not recognizing it as legal tender.
